what: API Wrapper to the Deribit Crypto Derivatives Exchange
title: API Wrapper to the Deribit Crypto Derivatives Exchange
text: R API wrapper Deribit crypto options derivatives exchange, supporting synchronous asynchronous (promise based) operations. Provides R6 market-data client public JSON-RPC endpoints — instruments, ticker, order book, index price, DVOL volatility index, funding rates, trades, option-chain book summaries — built shared connectcore transport base.

title: API Wrapper to the Deribit Crypto Derivatives Exchange
text: Deribit crypto options market lives — deepest venue BTC ETH options, perpetual dated futures alongside , DVOL volatility index whole desk watches regime dial. package gives Deribit’s public market data tidy data.tables: instrument universe, live quotes order books, DVOL candles, perpetual funding, recent trades, full option-chain snapshot. faithful, low-level wrapper: speaks Deribit’s JSON-RPC 2.0 wire format returns clean tables, preserving venue’s field names (snake_cased), editorialise data. Phase 1 public market data — trading authenticated surface, public endpoints need API key.

title: API Wrapper to the Deribit Crypto Derivatives Exchange
text: data.table everywhere, list columns. Every method returns one flat data.table; measurement columns (field legitimately absent given instrument kind — option’s greeks, perpetual’s funding, null bid) typed nullable, structural columns strict. Sync async. Every request-making surface works modes. async = TRUE returns [promise][promises::promise]; otherwise table returned directly. single sync/async branch point (inherited connectcore). Faithful field names. Venue-native names preserved snake_cased; nested objects (ticker’s stats/greeks) flattened parent field prefix (stats_high, greeks_delta). Typed errors. Every failure classed condition (deribit_api_error, deribit_validation_error) carrying structured fields — branch type, never grep message.

title: API Wrapper to the Deribit Crypto Derivatives Exchange
text: Set async = TRUE consume promise coro::async / await, driving event loop later:
code: box::use(coro, later)  md_async <- DeribitMarketData$new(async = TRUE)  main <- coro::async(function() {     dvol <- await(md_async$get_volatility_index_data(         "BTC",         start_timestamp = lubridate::now("UTC") - lubridate::days(7),         end_timestamp = lubridate::now("UTC"),         resolution = "3600"     ))     chain <- await(md_async$get_option_chain("BTC"))     print(list(dvol = dvol, chain = chain)) })  main() while (!later::loop_empty()) later::run_now()

title: Typed deribit conditions — deribit_conditions
text: Transport / API failures nest specific -> general deribit_api_error_<status> -> deribit_api_error -> connectcore_api_error_<status> -> connectcore_api_error -> connectcore_error, carrying fields status (HTTP status), code (Deribit's JSON-RPC error code, e.g. -32602), reason param (JSON-RPC error.data detail, present), url, body_snippet. Raised whenever Deribit response carries JSON-RPC error object (arrives HTTP 400), non-2xx HTTP status. Validation failures nest deribit_validation_error -> deribit_error (domain root). Raised malformed argument (e.g. unknown resolution kind, end_timestamp start_timestamp) request made. Deribit signs public request, request URL carries secret; url nonetheless stored connectcore::scrub_url() fleet uniformity, future authenticated surface inherits redaction free.

title: deribit return shapes — deribit_shapes
text: Reusable roxyassert @type shapes parsed deribit data.tables. Measurement columns (market prices, sizes, greeks, funding, venue field legitimately absent given instrument kind) typed | NA; structural columns (identifiers, instrument descriptors, sides, period timestamps, flags) strict. Faithful field names preserved verbatim snake_cased; nested JSON objects flattened parent field prefix (stats.high -> stats_high, greeks.delta -> greeks_delta). deribit leaf connector: nothing internal calls per-shape validator downstream package validates shapes, @genassert @exportassert; shapes exist expanded method's return contract.

title: deribit 0.1.0
text: Initial release: Deribit crypto-derivatives exchange fleet’s connector idiom — public market data . plain English: Deribit crypto options market lives, package fetches public market data — option futures universe, live quotes order books, DVOL volatility index (regime dial), perpetual funding rates, recent trades, whole option-chain snapshot — one typed, tested interface works synchronously asynchronously, research future strategy can consume Deribit data exactly way consumes every exchange’s. trading login phase; everything public, keyless surface.
